title: Callbacks, events, and the observer pattern — concept map
intro: Callback conventions, EventEmitter pub/sub, DOM events and delegation, callback hell, debounce/throttle implementations, and comparison to C# delegates.

overviewDiagram.title: Event-driven callback flow
overviewDiagram.source:
flowchart TD
  E[Event source] --> L[Listener registered]
  L --> H{Handler type}
  H -->|sync| R[Run on call stack]
  H -->|debounced| T[Timer reset]
  T --> R
  H -->|throttled| W[Window gate]
  W --> R

conceptCards.title: Callback patterns
conceptCards.summary: Error-first (err, data) in Node. Callback as value passed to higher-order functions.

conceptCards.title: EventEmitter pub/sub
conceptCards.summary: on/emit/off pattern. Node EventEmitter and custom buses. Memory leak if listeners not removed.

conceptCards.title: DOM events and delegation
conceptCards.summary: Bubbling and capturing phases. Delegate one listener on parent for many children.

conceptCards.title: Callback hell
conceptCards.summary: Nested callbacks before Promises. Named functions and modularization reduce pyramid.

conceptCards.title: Debounce and throttle
conceptCards.summary: Debounce: quiet period. Throttle: max rate. clearTimeout + closure. cancel on unmount.

conceptCards.title: Events vs C# delegates
conceptCards.summary: JS functions as callbacks. C# typed delegates and events with += unsubscribe.
